descriptions.sd-settings: Document number prefixes, alert windows and the rules the business decides — ship against delivered, required export documents.
descriptions.sales-order: Customer orders — buyer, style, PO, quantity by colour and size, rate, delivery and shipment dates.
descriptions.so-amendment: Controlled changes to an approved order — previous and revised quantity, price and dates, approved before they apply.
descriptions.order-confirmation: The order approval chain — submitted, checked, approved and confirmed — and the printed confirmation.
descriptions.delivery-chalan: The chalan raised when goods leave the gate, item-wise against its sales order.
descriptions.delivery-challan-return: Goods coming back on a delivered chalan, putting the quantity back on the order's balance.
descriptions.check-bill: Bills verified against the chalan and the order rate, approved and marked paid.
descriptions.delivery-completion: Order-wise delivered, returned, net delivered and balance — pending, partial or completed.
descriptions.so-month-closing: Month-end closing of sales orders — what is still open, and the lock on the period.
descriptions.sc-delivery-list: Goods delivered out to a sub-contractor, with the challan and quantity sent.
descriptions.sc-receive-list: Goods received back from a sub-contractor, reconciled against what was sent.
descriptions.sc-pending: What is still out with each sub-contractor, against its expected return date, overdue first.
descriptions.sc-return: Received goods sent back to the sub-contractor — a rejection returned for rework.
descriptions.sc-reconciliation: Delivered against received, rejected and short for each S/C chalan, reconciled to zero.
descriptions.shipment-planning: Shipments planned against a confirmed order — partial shipments, ex-factory date, destination and quantity.
descriptions.shipment-booking: Space booked with a forwarder or shipping line — vessel, voyage, ETD, ETA and ports.
descriptions.container-vessel: The containers a shipment is loaded into — seal, weights, CBM, cartons and vessel.
descriptions.commercial-doc-handover: Shipment documents handed from the commercial desk to shipping, and who received them.
descriptions.shipment-invoice: The commercial invoice for a shipment — consignee, terms, lines and currency-wise totals.
descriptions.packing-list: Carton-wise packing by colour and size, with pieces, weights and CBM.
descriptions.shipment-confirmation: The pre-shipment checklist — quantity, invoice, packing list, container, booking and documents — and the confirmation.
descriptions.shipment-closing: Confirmed shipments closed with their invoice value, vessel, containers and documents on record.
descriptions.export-documents: The EXP and the inspection, insurance and other export documents on a shipment's checklist.
descriptions.certificate-management: Certificates issued for a shipment, typed from the Certificate Master, with expiry tracking.
descriptions.certificate-of-origin: Certificates of origin filed against each shipment.
descriptions.gsp-rex: GSP forms and REX statements that carry a shipment's preferential tariff.
descriptions.bl-awb: The bill of lading or air waybill a shipment travels on.
descriptions.document-handover: The final set of shipment documents handed to the buyer or the bank, sender and receiver on record.
descriptions.shipment-attachments: Scans and files kept against a shipment, by document type and uploader.
descriptions.order-tracking: One sales order traced from booking to closing.
descriptions.sd-alerts: Live sales and shipment alerts, each with the screen it is cleared on.

set.defaults_note: Not saved yet — these are the defaults until the settings are first saved.
set.edit_sub: Rewriting :no. Save to keep the changes, or cancel to leave it as it was.
set.ship_label: Ship only what has been delivered
set.ship_hint: Ticked, a shipment may carry no more than the order's net delivered quantity. Unticked, it may carry anything still unshipped on the order.
set.docs_label: Require export documents before confirming a shipment
set.docs_hint: Ticked, a shipment cannot be confirmed until its EXP and its B/L or AWB are filed, and Document Pending alerts are raised.
set.due_hint: How far ahead delivery, shipment, booking and document alerts start. 1 to 365.
set.cert_hint: How far ahead an expiring certificate or export document is flagged. 1 to 365.
set.prefix_hint: 2 to 6 capital letters, different from every other series.
set.width_hint: Digits in the running number: :n prints :example. 4 to 8.
set.footer: Saved settings apply to every new Sales & Shipment number from now on.
set.read_only: Your role can view these settings but not change them.
set.search: Search the Sales & Shipment settings: shipping rules, alert windows, document numbering

v.close_open_amendment: :no has an amendment still open — apply, reject or cancel it first.
v.not_confirmed: :no is not a confirmed open order.
v.sc_lines: Give at least one line going out.
v.sc_over: No more than the ordered :max can go out on a line.
v.target_before_sc: The target date cannot fall before the SC date.
v.locked: :no is :status — only a draft is changed.
v.step: :no is :status — that step is not open to it.
v.am_lines: Give at least one size to revise.
v.am_reason: Say why the order is changing.
v.am_size_twice: A size is revised once per amendment.
v.am_order_fixed: :no keeps the order it was raised against.
v.am_open: :no already carries open amendment :amend — one at a time.
v.am_floor: :line cannot go below :floor — that much has already gone out.
v.dc_order_fixed: :no keeps the order it was raised against.
v.dc_not_confirmed: Only a confirmed order can be shipped against — :no is not.
v.dc_lines: Warning! Please select at least one SO item.
v.dc_over: :line can ship no more than :max — what the order still owes plus its overage.
v.delete_draft: Only a draft is deleted — :no is past that.
v.dr_reason: Choose why the goods came back.
v.dr_challan_fixed: :no keeps the challan it was raised against.
v.dr_not_delivered: Only a delivered challan takes a return — :no is not delivered.
v.dr_before: A return cannot be dated before its challan (:date).
v.cb_lines: Bill at least one delivered line.
v.cb_not_delivered: Only a delivered challan line can be billed.
v.cb_other_customer: :no is another customer's challan — one bill is for one customer.
v.cb_over: :line can be billed for no more than :max.
v.cb_deduction: The deduction cannot be more than the gross (:gross).
v.mc_period: Type the month as 2026-07 or Jul/2026.
v.mc_future: A month that has not begun cannot be closed.
v.mc_exceptions: :n exception(s) still stand in the month — clear them, or have an administrator close over them.
v.mc_admin: Only an administrator may close a month over its exceptions.
v.scd_target: The delivery target cannot fall before the chalan date.
v.scd_contract_fixed: :no keeps the contract it was raised against.
v.scd_order_closed: The order behind :no is closed — nothing more goes out against it.
v.scd_lines: Warning! Please select at least one Sales Contract item.
v.scd_over: :line can send out no more than :max — what the contract still owes.
v.scd_locked: :no is :status — it can no longer be rewritten.
v.scr_locked: :no is finalized, cancelled, has returns against it or its chalan is closed — it cannot change.
v.scr_has_returns: :no has returns against it — cancel those first.
v.scr_chalan_fixed: :no keeps the challan it was booked against.
v.scr_not_out: Only a delivered, open S/C chalan takes this — :no is not.
v.scr_before: A receipt cannot be dated before its chalan (:date).
v.scr_lines: Give at least one line that came back.
v.scr_over: :line can come back no more than :max — what is still out.
v.sct_reason: Choose why the goods go back.
v.sct_receipt_fixed: :no keeps the receipt it was raised against.
v.sct_receipt_open: Only a received receipt on an open chalan can be returned against — :no is not.
v.sct_before: A return cannot be dated before its receipt (:date).
v.sct_lines: Send back at least one line.
v.sct_over: :line can send back no more than :max.
v.scc_locked: :no is reconciled — only an administrator can reopen it.
v.scc_chalan_fixed: :no keeps the chalan it was raised against.
v.scc_open: :no already has open reconciliation :recon — one at a time.
v.scc_short_over: :line can be short no more than :max — what is still out.
v.scc_not_squared: :no still has goods out with the party — it cannot be reconciled yet.
v.sp_locked: :no is :stage — the plan can no longer be rewritten.
v.sp_ex_factory: The ex-factory date cannot fall after the shipment date.
v.sp_order_fixed: :no keeps the order it was planned against.
v.sp_lines: A shipment plan needs at least one order line.
v.sp_over: :line can plan no more than :max — what the order still has unplanned.
v.sp_over_delivered: :line can plan no more than :max — Ship Against Delivered is on and that is what has been delivered and not yet planned.
v.sp_delete: Only a plan still being planned is deleted — cancel :no instead.
v.eta_before_etd: The ETA cannot fall before the ETD.
v.bk_delete: Only a requested or cancelled booking is deleted — :no is not.
v.shp_not_open: :no is :stage — it is no longer being prepared.
v.ct_no: A container number is four capital letters and seven digits, like MSKU1234567.
v.ct_shipment_fixed: Container :no keeps its shipment — remove it and add it to the other one.
v.dh_locked: :no has been received — it is locked.
v.dh_paper: :no is not a live paper of :shipment.
v.dh_delete: Only a pending handover is removed — :no is past that.
v.si_shipment_fixed: :no keeps the shipment it was raised for.
v.si_lines: An invoice needs at least one line.
v.pl_from: Carton ranges start at 1 or above.
v.pl_to: Give the last carton of every run.
v.pl_lines: A packing list needs at least one carton run.
v.pl_overlap: Row :row overlaps the cartons of row :other.
v.pl_gross: Row :row: gross weight is below net weight.
v.pl_over: :line packs :qty, more than the :max still to pack.
v.cf_not_ready: :no is not ready — still to pass: :checks.
v.sp_papered: :no has an invoice or a packing list — its plan lines are locked.
v.ed_expiry: The expiry date cannot fall before the issue date.
v.ed_closed: :no is :stage — it takes no further documents.
v.ce_name: Name the certificate, or choose its type.
v.sa_type: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP files are accepted.

v.sr_range: To Date cannot be before From Date.

od.empty_text: Change the search above and load again.

confirm.delete: Delete :no? A draft is removed for good.

ed.no_records: No records to choose from yet.
ed.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
ed.pick_left: Pick the order on the left-hand list and this fills in with it.

entry.title: Sales Order Entry
entry.hint: Book a customer order: the master data, the item lines, the sizes under each line and the particulars that travel with them are saved together.

so.locked: :no is :status — it changes only through a Sales Order Amendment now.

f.so_no_hint: Issued on save, from the receive date and that day's sequence.
f.same_as_bill_to_hint: Ticked, the delivery party is taken from Bill To on save.
f.lead_time_hint: Derived on save: receive date to delivery target.
f.conv_rate_hint: Local currency per unit of the order currency.
f.additional_qty_hint: Overage the customer allows. Deliveries beyond order plus overage are refused.
f.additional_qty_ph: additional % of total sales delivery qty
f.shipment_date_hint: The buyer's ship date. It cannot fall before the receive date.
f.items_hint: The item family this order is placed for. Each line may still name its own.
f.is_poly_hint: Poly and cartons are ordered by weight rather than by piece.
f.note: Buyer, Style and Order match the references written on the order's own lines; every other box narrows the header. Leave them all blank and the most recent orders are listed.

lines.title: Details Data — item lines
lines.hint: One row per item, colour and rate. SL# numbers the line; the two grids below hang their rows off it.
lines.empty: A sales order with no lines posts nothing, so at least one is required before this can be saved.

sizes.title: GMT Size | Product
sizes.hint: The size band under an item line. SL# is the line's number in the grid above.
sizes.empty: An order line with no size has no quantity — add at least one row per line.

part.title: Other Particular
part.hint: Named attributes carried on an item line — the pairs the printed grid adds with its plus button.
part.empty: Optional. An order line needs no particulars to be complete.

so.empty_title: No sales order matches that search
so.footer: A new order is saved as a draft; submit it for approval on Order Confirmation. Saving replaces a draft's lines with exactly what is in the three grids. Once an order has been submitted it can no longer be edited here — raise a Sales Order Amendment instead.

sc.title: S/C Programme
sc.hint: Put a sales order's work out to a sub-contractor. The programme number this writes is the SC No the two S/C lists are read by.

lines.title: Programme Lines
lines.hint: What is going out, and at what rate the party is paid.
lines.empty: Pick an order on the left to load its lines.

sc.order_fixed: A saved programme keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.
sc.footer: Pick an order on the left; its lines drop into the grid with the quantity still to be delivered. A line going out at zero is left off the programme.

am.title: Sales Order Amendment Entry
am.hint: Change an approved order's quantities, prices or dates without overwriting it: the amendment records what each figure was and what it becomes, and is applied only once approved.
am.locked: :no is :status — only a draft is edited.
am.order_fixed: A saved amendment keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.reason_ph: Why the order is changing — buyer revision, price renegotiation…
f.revised_shipment_hint: Left blank, the order keeps its current shipment date.
f.note: Every amendment ever raised against an order is kept, applied or not — read together they are the order's version history.

lines.title: Size-wise Revision
lines.hint: One row per size band. The current quantity and rate are the order's own and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Pick an order on the left to load its sizes.

confirm.submit: Submitting sends the amendment for approval. It can no longer be edited.
confirm.approve: Approving records you as the approver of these revised figures.
confirm.reject: Rejecting closes the amendment. The order stays as it is.
confirm.apply: Applying writes the revised quantities, rates and dates onto the order and moves it to the next version. The order as it stands now is kept as a snapshot.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling withdraws the amendment. The order stays as it is.

done.apply: :no applied — the order moved to its next version.

am.footer: Pick the order on the left; its sizes drop into the grid with today's quantity and rate. Type the revised figures and a reason. A line cannot go below what has already been delivered or planned for shipment. An amendment is edited only while it is a draft, and an order carries one open amendment at a time.

f.note: Buyer matches the buyer written on the order's own lines; every other box narrows the header. Leave them all blank and the most recent orders are listed.

oc.empty_title: No order confirmation matches that search

confirm.submit: Submitting sends the order for checking. It can no longer be edited on the entry form unless it is returned to draft.
confirm.approve: Approving records you as the approver of this order's quantities, prices and dates.
confirm.confirm: Confirming finalizes the order: it can be delivered and shipped against, and from now on it changes only through a Sales Order Amendment.
confirm.return: Returning to draft clears the approval trail so the order can be corrected and submitted again.
confirm.close: Closing ends the order: nothing more can be delivered, shipped or amended against it.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — it can be delivered against now.

dc.title: Delivery Chalan Entry
dc.hint: Raise the chalan the goods leave the gate on. Pick the sales order on the left and the lines still to ship drop into the grid.
dc.locked: :no is :status — its lines can no longer be changed.
dc.order_fixed: A saved chalan keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.store_hint: Delivery Through — the store the goods physically leave from.
f.gate_pass_hint: Issued with the chalan number, so the gate and the desk quote the same reference.
f.note: Buyer, Style, Order and Section match the references on the delivered order lines; the rest narrow the chalan header.

side.title: SO List
side.search: Search SO No, PO/WO or customer…

lines.title: Details Data
lines.hint: What is going out on this chalan. Ordered, already delivered and the balance are the order's own figures and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Warning! Please select at least one SO item — pick a sales order on the left to load its lines.

dc.empty_title: No delivery chalan matches that search

confirm.submit: Submitting hands the chalan to the gate. Its lines can no longer be changed.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the delivered quantity back onto the sales order.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its quantity is back on the order.

dc.footer: Only a confirmed order can be shipped against. A line cannot ship more than the order still owes — ordered, less delivered, plus whatever has come back on confirmed returns — plus whatever overage the order allows. Saving replaces the chalan's lines with exactly what is in the grid; a chalan that has been billed or returned against is locked.

dr.title: Delivery Challan Return Entry
dr.hint: Record goods a customer sends back against a delivery challan. Pick the challan on the left and its lines drop in with what was delivered and what has already come back.
dr.locked: :no is :status — a confirmed or cancelled return is locked.
dr.challan_fixed: A saved return keeps its challan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: A draft return changes nothing. Confirming it puts the returned quantity back on the order's delivery balance; cancelling a confirmed one takes it off again.

side.title: Delivered Challan List
side.search: Search chalan no, SO no or customer…

lines.title: Returned Goods
lines.hint: One row per challan line. Item, delivered quantity and what earlier returns brought back are the challan's own facts and are shown, not typed. Leave a line at zero to return none of it.
lines.empty: Pick a delivered challan on the left to load the lines that can be returned.

dr.empty_title: No challan return matches that search

confirm.confirm: Confirming puts the returned quantity back on the sales order's delivery balance. The return can no longer be edited.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling a confirmed return takes the quantity back off the order's delivery balance.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — the quantity is back on the order.

dr.footer: A line cannot return more than the challan delivered, less every other return against it that is not cancelled. Saving keeps the return as a draft — the order's delivery balance changes only when the return is confirmed on the register. A confirmed or cancelled return is locked.

cb.title: Check Bill Entry
cb.hint: Bill the deliveries a customer has taken. Pick a challan on the left and its lines drop in with the delivered quantity beside the box you bill.
cb.locked: :no is :status — a verified, approved or paid bill is locked.
cb.other_customer: :no is another customer's challan — one bill is for one customer.
cb.customer_fixed: Remove the lines first to bill another customer.

f.loc_rate_hint: BDT per unit of the bill currency. The BDT column is struck at this rate.
f.deduction_hint: Taken off the gross of the lines, in the bill currency — short delivery, quality claim, discount. Net = Gross − Deduction.
f.remarks_hint: [BILL_NO], [BILL_DATE] and [SECTION] are filled in from the bill on save.
f.remarks_default: Being the amount party debited for [SECTION] bill purpose as enclosed bill no [BILL_NO] bill date :[BILL_DATE].
f.action_status_hint: A draft can still be edited; a submitted bill waits on the approver.
f.note: A submitted bill is verified, then approved, then paid. It is finalized once approved — the quantities on it are then locked against the challans they were drawn from. A verified bill can no longer be edited; reject it to send it back.

lines.title: Bill Details
lines.hint: One row per delivered line. Challan, item, delivered quantity, unit and what is already billed are the challan's own facts and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: Pick a delivery challan on the left to load the lines it can be billed for.

cb.empty_title: No check bill matches that search

confirm.verify: Verifying confirms the quantities, rates and deduction against the challans. The bill can no longer be edited.
confirm.approve: Approving finalizes the bill and locks the challans it draws on.
confirm.pay: Marking the bill paid records that the customer has settled it.
confirm.reject: Rejecting sends the bill back to the desk that raised it.

cb.footer: A line cannot be billed for more than was delivered, less whatever another bill has already claimed. Net is the gross of the lines less the deduction. Save keeps the bill as a draft; Submit For Approval sends it to verification, and a verified, approved or paid bill is locked.
cb.saved: Check bill :no saved as a draft.

f.note: Net Delivered is delivered less confirmed returns; Balance is Order Qty less Net Delivered. Days counts to the delivery target — negative once it has passed.

mc.title: Parameters
mc.note: Show Exception lists everything in the month that would stop the close — undelivered orders, open chalans, bills not yet approved, orders whose shipment is still pending, draft challan and S/C returns, and amendments not yet applied. Month Close refuses while any of them stand, unless an administrator ticks the override.

f.period_hint: The month being locked. Both 2026-07 and Jul/2026 are accepted.
f.remarks_ph: Why this month is being closed…
f.override_hint: Only an administrator may close a month that still has exceptions. The override and what was open are recorded with the close.

mc.need_period: Type the month first — 2026-07 or Jul/2026.

confirm.close: Closing locks the month: no order, chalan, bill, return or S/C paper may be dated inside it afterwards.
confirm.reopen: Reopening unlocks the month and releases the orders it closed. Anything posted afterwards falls into an already-reported period.

ex.title: What would stop :period closing
ex.none: Nothing stands in the way — the month can be closed.

mc.empty_title: No month has been closed against sales orders yet.
mc.empty_text: Close a month above once everything in it is settled.

scd.title: Sales Contract Delivery Entry
scd.hint: Send a sub-contract's work out to the party. Pick the contract on the left and its outstanding lines drop into the grid.
scd.locked: :no is :status — it can no longer be rewritten.
scd.contract_fixed: A saved chalan keeps its contract — clear the form to start a new one.

f.transfer_from_hint: Set only when the goods move party to party without coming back through the gate.
f.note: The dates narrow on the delivery target, which is what the sub-contract is chased on — not on the day the chalan was written.

side.title: SC List
side.search: Search SC No, SO No or party…

lines.hint: What is going out to the party. Contracted, already sent and the balance are the contract's own figures.
lines.empty: Warning! Please select at least one Sales Contract item — pick a contract on the left to load its lines.

scd.empty_title: No S/C delivery chalan matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalising locks the chalan. Its lines can no longer be changed, and only receipts may be booked against it.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the quantity back onto the sales contract.

scd.footer: A line cannot send out more than the contract still owes. A finalized chalan is locked, and one with receipts against it can no longer be rewritten.

scr.title: SC Receive Entry
scr.hint: Book back what the sub-contractor returns. Pick the challan on the left and the lines still out drop into the grid.
scr.locked_note: :no is :status — its quantities can no longer be changed.
scr.chalan_fixed: A saved receipt keeps its challan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Finished goods, left-over material and rejections are all receipts and are told apart by Receive Type — an S/C balance that cannot separate them is not a balance.

side.title: S/C Challan List
side.search: Search chalan no, SC no or party…

lines.hint: What came back. Sent, already returned and the balance are the challan's own figures.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C challan on the left to load the lines still out with the party.

scr.empty_title: No S/C receipt matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalising locks the receipt. Its quantities can no longer be changed.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling takes the received quantity back off the S/C balance.

scr.footer: Finished goods, left-over material and rejections are all receipts and are told apart by Receive Type. A line cannot come back for more than went out on that challan.

f.note: Pending is what went out, less what came back, plus what was sent back out again. A line is overdue once its chalan's delivery target has passed with anything still pending. A reconciled (closed) chalan counts as completed — whatever it was short was written off there.

scp.empty_title: Nothing is out with a sub-contractor for that search

sct.title: Sub-Contract Return Entry
sct.hint: Send received goods back to the sub-contractor. Pick the receipt on the left and the lines that can still go back drop into the grid.
sct.receipt_fixed: A saved return keeps its receipt — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Only a confirmed return moves the S/C balance. A draft is a return nobody has agreed to yet, and a cancelled one sends nothing.

side.title: S/C Receive List
side.search: Search MRR no, chalan no or party…

lines.hint: What goes back to the party. Received, rejected and previously returned are the receipt's own figures.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C receipt on the left to load the lines that can still be sent back.

sct.empty_title: No S/C return matches that search

confirm.confirm: Confirming puts the returned quantity back out with the party on the S/C chalan. The return can no longer be edited.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling takes the returned quantity back off the S/C chalan's pending balance.

done.confirm: :no confirmed — the quantity is back out with the party.

sct.footer: A line cannot send back more than came in on that receipt line, less what other returns already send back. Saving keeps the return a draft; it moves nothing until it is confirmed on the register.

scc.title: Sub-Contract Reconciliation Entry
scc.hint: Square an S/C chalan against what came back. Pick the chalan on the left, record anything agreed short, and save to work out the balance.
scc.locked_note: :no is reconciled — locked until an administrator reopens it.
scc.chalan_fixed: A saved reconciliation keeps its chalan — clear the form to start a new one.

f.note: Pending still has goods out with the party. Matched, Short and Excess are squared and can be reconciled, which closes the S/C chalan.

lines.hint: One line per chalan line. The quantities are the chalan's own; Balance is what is still out less what is short, and is worked out when you save.
lines.empty: Pick an S/C chalan on the left to load its lines.

confirm.reconcile: Reconciling signs the chalan off and closes it. The figures are locked, and only an administrator can reopen it.
confirm.reopen: Reopening un-closes the S/C chalan and unlocks the reconciliation for changes.

scc.footer: Delivered, received, rejected and returned are read off the chalan when you save — only Short is yours to enter. Short cannot exceed what is still out. A chalan has one open reconciliation at a time, and a reconciled one is locked until an administrator reopens it.

sp.title: Shipment Plan Entry
sp.hint: Plan one shipment of a confirmed order. Pick the order on the left and the lines still to plan drop into the grid.
sp.locked: :no is :stage — the plan can no longer be rewritten here.
sp.order_fixed: A saved plan keeps its order — clear the form to start a new one.

f.order_hint: Only confirmed orders are offered. Pick one on the left and this fills in with it.
f.ex_factory_hint: The day the goods leave the factory — on or before the shipment date.
f.note: The dates narrow on the shipment date the buyer expects, not on the day the plan was written.

side.title: Order List
side.search: Search SO No, PO or customer…

lines.title: Planned Lines
lines.hint: What ships on this plan. Order qty, what other shipments have already planned and the balance are the order's own figures and are shown, not typed.
lines.empty: A shipment plan needs at least one order line — pick a confirmed order on the left to load its lines.

sp.empty_title: No shipment plan matches that search

confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the planned quantity back onto the sales order. Its booking and documents stay on file against a cancelled shipment.

done.cancel: :no cancelled — its quantity is back on the order.

sp.against_delivered: Ship Against Delivered is on in the settings: a line plans no more than the order has net delivered, less what other shipments planned.
sp.footer: A line cannot plan more than the order still has unplanned, counting every other shipment that is not cancelled. Saving replaces the plan's lines with exactly what is in the grid; once an invoice or a packing list has been raised on the shipment its lines are locked.
sp.papered: :no has an invoice or a packing list — its plan lines are locked.

f.shipment_hint: Only shipments still being prepared are offered.

bk.title: Shipment Booking
bk.hint: Book space for a shipment with a forwarder or shipping line.
bk.note: The booking number is issued on save. A booking counts towards the shipment's shipping details once it is confirmed and carries a vessel and an ETD.

f.eta_hint: Must not fall before the ETD.

confirm.confirm: Confirming records that the line has accepted the booking.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling withdraws the booking. The shipment will need another before it can be confirmed.

ct.title: Container / Vessel Details
ct.hint: Record a container a shipment is loaded into.
ct.note: Vessel, voyage, ETD and ETA left blank are taken from the booking. A container number is four letters and seven digits, and appears once per shipment.

f.booking_hint: Choosing a booking fills in its vessel, voyage and dates.
f.type_hint: Left blank, the booking's container type is used.

dh.title: Commercial Document Handover
dh.hint: Commercial → Shipping: the documents of a shipment handed over, and who received them.
dh.note: Commercial → Shipping. The handover number is issued on save. Move it along with the row actions — Mark Received needs the receiver's name on record. A received handover is locked; only a pending one can be removed.

f.list_hint: Anything handed over beyond the invoice, packing list, EXP and certificate above.
f.attachment_hint: The scanned papers — PDF or image, up to 10 MB.
f.attached: Attached: :name — choose a file to replace it.

confirm.returned: Marking returned records that the documents came back — they will need handing over again.

dh.upload_failed: The handover was saved, but the attachment did not upload.

si.title: Shipment Invoice Entry
si.hint: Raise the commercial invoice for a shipment. Pick the shipment on the left and its un-invoiced lines drop into the grid.
si.locked: :no is :status — only a draft can be changed.
si.shipment_fixed: A saved paper keeps its shipment — clear the form to start a new one.

f.commercial_hint: The Commercial module's invoice for the same consignment, when there is one.
f.note: Currency totals above the list leave cancelled invoices out — a cancelled invoice bills nothing.

lines.title: Invoice Lines
lines.hint: What this invoice bills. The quantity opens on what is still un-invoiced on the shipment line.
lines.empty: Pick a shipment on the left to load its lines — an invoice with no lines bills nothing.

si.empty_title: No shipment invoice matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalizing locks the invoice. It then counts towards the shipment's readiness and cannot be edited, only cancelled.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the invoiced quantity back onto the shipment lines.

si.footer: Only a shipment that has not been confirmed can be invoiced. A line cannot invoice more than the shipment carries less what other live invoices already claim. Amount is Qty × Unit Price, worked out again on save. Only a draft invoice can be changed or removed; finalize it from the register once it is right.

pl.title: Packing List Entry
pl.hint: Pack a shipment carton by carton. Pick the shipment on the left and its unpacked lines drop into the grid; type each carton range and its pack size.

f.invoice_hint: The shipment invoice these cartons travel under, when it has been raised.

lines.title: Carton-wise Packing
lines.hint: One row per carton run. A shipment line packed in several colours, sizes or pack sizes takes several rows.
lines.empty: Pick a shipment on the left to load its lines — a packing list with no cartons packs nothing.

pl.empty_title: No packing list matches that search

confirm.finalize: Finalizing locks the packing list. It then counts towards the shipment's readiness.
confirm.cancel: Cancelling releases the packed pieces back onto the shipment lines.

pl.footer: Cartons is To − From + 1 and PCS is Cartons × PCS/Carton, both worked out on save. Carton ranges must start at 1 or above and may not overlap within the list. A shipment line cannot be packed beyond its shipment quantity across all live packing lists. Gross weight may not be below net weight. Only a draft packing list can be changed.

f.title: Checklist
f.note: Confirm refuses until every check passes. Confirming writes the quantities on the shipment's final invoices as shipped, against the shipment and its order.
f.shipment_hint: Search narrows the list to it; Check lists its readiness in full.

hint.qty: Final invoices bill something, never more than the shipment carries, and the final packing lists pack exactly what they bill.
hint.booking: A confirmed or completed booking with a vessel and an ETD.
hint.container: At least one container — needed for sea and sea-air shipments.
hint.invoice: At least one final shipment invoice.
hint.packing: At least one final packing list.
hint.documents: With export documents required in the settings, the EXP and the B/L or AWB filed (Export Documentation).

confirm.confirm: Confirming declares the goods shipped. The final invoices' quantities are written onto the shipment and the sales order.
confirm.unconfirm: Unconfirming takes the shipped quantities back off the shipment and its order, and returns it to the stage its paperwork shows.

confirm.close: Closing marks the shipment's file complete. Only an administrator can reopen it.
confirm.reopen: Reopening puts the shipment back among the confirmed ones, so its file can be corrected.

cl.empty_text: Shipments appear here once they are confirmed on Shipment Confirmation.

ed.note: A document number is unique per document type. A closed or cancelled shipment takes no further documents. The Expiry column warns inside the alert window set in Sales & Shipment settings.

f.shipment_hint: A closed or cancelled shipment takes no further documents.

confirm.delete: Remove this document from its shipment?

export.title: EXP / Export Documents
export.hint: File the EXP and the inspection, insurance and other export documents on a shipment's checklist.
export.empty_title: No export documents document matches that search

coo.title: COO / Certificate of Origin
coo.hint: File a certificate of origin against a shipment.
coo.empty_title: No certificate of origin document matches that search

gsp.title: GSP / REX
gsp.hint: File the GSP form or REX statement that carries a shipment's preferential tariff.
gsp.empty_title: No gsp / rex document matches that search

blawb.title: Bill of Lading / AWB
blawb.hint: File the bill of lading or air waybill a shipment travels on.
blawb.empty_title: No B/L / AWB document matches that search

ce.title: Certificate Management
ce.hint: Record a certificate issued for a shipment.
ce.note: A certificate number is unique within its shipment. Validity is worked out from the expiry date against the alert window in Sales & Shipment settings. A closed or cancelled shipment's certificates can no longer be changed.

f.type_hint: From the Certificate Master (Company Documents). Brings its issuing authority with it.
f.name: Certificate Name
f.name_hint: Left blank, the certificate type's title.

confirm.delete: Remove this certificate from its shipment?

fh.title: Document Handover
fh.hint: The final set of shipment documents handed to the buyer or the bank.
fh.note: Final Handover. The handover number is issued on save. Move it along with the row actions — Mark Received needs the receiver's name on record. A received handover is locked; only a pending one can be removed.

f.list_hint: The documents handed to the buyer or the bank — one per line, as they are checked off.

fh.empty_title: No document handover matches that search

sa.title: Shipment Attachments
sa.hint: Keep a scan or file against a shipment.
sa.note: Only PDF, PNG, JPEG and WebP files of up to 5 MB are accepted. Editing without choosing a new file keeps the one already attached.

f.title: File Name
f.title_hint: How the document is referred to — the stored file is renamed on upload.
f.file_hint: PDF, PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 5 MB.

confirm.delete: Remove this attachment from its shipment?

sr.title: Sales & Shipment Reports
sr.hint: The module's report set. Pick one, narrow it with the boxes it takes, and Preview runs it against the live tables.
sr.note: A box the chosen report does not read is disabled rather than hidden, so the parameters stay in the same place whichever report is picked. Values on the Sales & Shipment reports are in BDT, converted at each challan's own rate and at the order's rate for order lines and shipment invoices. Pending is Order Qty less the larger of net delivered and shipped, so goods delivered and then shipped are not counted twice. A status applies only to the report it names.

kind.monthly-sales-summary: Monthly Sales Summary (by order month, BDT)

ot.title: Order Timeline
ot.caption: Every event on one sales order in the order it happened — approval, amendments, deliveries and returns, bills, sub-contract papers, shipment documents, confirmation and closing — with its date, reference, quantity, value, status and who acted
ot.order_hint: Every order is offered, newest first — a closed order can still be traced.
ot.pick: Pick a sales order and press Load to trace it from booking to closing.
ot.note: Delivery Balance is Order Qty less Net Delivered (delivered less returned); Shipment Balance is Order Qty less Shipped. When the module ships against delivered goods, Available is what has been delivered and not yet shipped, and Balance is Order Qty less the larger of Net Delivered and Shipped, so a carton delivered and then shipped is counted once. Otherwise delivery and shipment are separate ways out, Available is the Shipment Balance, and the two balances are read on their own.
ot.empty: No event on this order yet.
ot.head: :no · :customer

against.off: Delivery and shipment are separate ways out

al.title: Alerts
al.caption: Live sales and shipment alerts with their kind, severity, document reference, party, due date, days to or past it, detail and the screen each is cleared on
al.note: Worked out from the papers each time the screen opens — nothing to dismiss: an alert clears itself once its paper moves on. Due alerts look :days days ahead and certificates :cert days ahead (Sales & Shipment Settings).
al.empty_title: No alert — every order and shipment is on time

d.closing: All :qty delivered or shipped — the order can be closed
d.subcon: :back of :qty back · :out still with the party
